# OligoVigil

> 658 human curator-verified safety and off-target evidence rows for therapeutic oligonucleotides, with provenance and benchmark-ready release data. Curation was AI-assisted: a single human curator adjudicated v2 LLM proposals over the source passages (re-curating 2003 v1 machine pre-curated candidates; 1345 unsupported ones were demoted). Machine-only rows are labelled machine_precurated_v1 and are not release evidence. Inter-curator (Cohen kappa) agreement is not yet reported.

Base URL: use the public OligoVigil URL after deployment; use `http://127.0.0.1:8077` only for local testing.

Critical rules:

- Verified release evidence supports claims; candidates are gap-finding context only.
- Do not infer clinical safety or de novo off-target risk from OligoVigil alone.
- Use `/api/evidence_detail?domain={toxicity|offtarget}&id={id}` for citable record-level provenance.
- Include PMID/DOI, evidence grade, source location, OligoVigil version, and audit status when summarizing evidence.
- Raw article text is not redistributed.

Universal connection:

- `/agent.json`: first discovery file for agentic clients, coding tools, and API importers.
- `/.well-known/oligovigil-agent.json`: same universal manifest under a well-known path.
- `/.well-known/ai-plugin.json`: OpenAPI action/plugin-style manifest.
- `/mcp.json`: generic MCP client configuration.
- `/api/agent_connect`: connection profiles and entrypoints.
- `/api/openapi.json`: REST API schema.
- `/nlweb.json`: natural-language tool discovery for agentic web clients.
- `/bioschemas.json`: Dataset JSON-LD for search and AI discovery.

Primary endpoints:

- `/api/search`
- `/api/evidence_records`
- `/api/evidence_detail`
- `/api/safety_triage`
- `/api/safety_dossier`
- `/api/evidence_graph`
- `/api/prov_graph`
- `/api/sequence_search`
- `/api/modification_profile`
- `/api/benchmark`
- `/api/download/evidence_release.csv`
- `/api/download/benchmark_reference_splits.csv`
- `/api/download/all_tables.zip`
- `/api/download/oligovigil_agent_pack.zip`

Agent metadata:

- `/api/agent_access`
- `/api/agent_connect`
- `/llms-full.txt`
- `/api/openapi.json`
